claim: Elevated inflation is largely explained by transitory factors.

contradiction_rule.first_contradiction_at: The first release date after assumption_adopted_at whose point-in-time year-over-year value is above the threshold.

support_patterns: inflation (?:has risen|is elevated), largely reflecting (?:factors that are expected to be )?transitory factors
flip_patterns: supply and demand imbalances.*continued to contribute to elevated levels of inflation
phrase_set.flip_rule: The first statement on or after first_contradiction_at that matches a flip pattern and no support pattern.

disclosures: statement_flip_at is an observable language proxy, not a claim about unobserved internal recognition or causality.
action lag can reflect deliberate policy pacing and is not classified as organizational forgetting.
Only DFEDTAR or DFEDTARL/DFEDTARU changes close the policy response event.
